request.description: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces. Draw the flat top of a sealed industrial spacecraft process-water silo inside a square steel deck frame: a large circular pressure dome filling the frame, a bolted outer rim, one thin teal service band ringing the dome, a central round inspection hatch with a single lift handle, a narrow vertical level-gauge strip along the right edge, four corner fasteners. Worn grey-blue painted steel, restrained contrast, coarse deliberate pixel clusters, utilitarian retro spaceship salvage-yard machinery. Complete silhouette filling the square canvas, transparent outside the frame. No perspective, no ground shadow, no pipes leaving the frame, no text, numbers or logos.

attempts.review: Overhead, but background removal made the dome fill and frame transparent (floating rings); hatch handle reads as a warning sign.
